Südkorea · 제주특별자치도 · 45 Alle Städte

Jeju Province (제주특별자치도) — Südkorea Reiseführer: Sehenswürdigkeiten, Anreise & Spezialitäten

Seongsan Ilchulbong Sunrise Peak, Hallasan National Park, Jeju Olle Walking Trails, Udo Island & Manjanggul Lava Tube. 1-hour flight from Seoul Gimpo (GMP) or Busan to Jeju International Airport (CJU); island express buses and rental cars.

Region / KantonJeju Province (제주특별자치도)
VerkehrsknotenpunktJeju-si Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)
Alle Städte45

Anreise & Nahverkehr

1-hour flight from Seoul Gimpo (GMP) or Busan to Jeju International Airport (CJU); island express buses and rental cars.

Lokale Küche & Spezialitäten

  • Jeju Black Pork BBQ (Heukdwaeji)
  • Abalone porridge (Jeonbokjuk)
  • Hairtail fish (Galchi jorim)
  • Hallabong citrus sweets
  • Gogi guksu (pork noodle soup)
